scientific_result.statement: For s=1/12, arbitrary cap-one X, H_ell=sqrt(ell)X+sqrt(1-ell)G1, and any symmetric orthogonal B with spectrum {1,1,-1}, the cone-tip density of (H_ell,G2,G3)^T B(H_ell,G2,G3) is at most 3sqrt(2), strictly below for ell>0.
scientific_result.exact_family: B=I-2nn^T with n=(1,2,3)/sqrt(14); one leverage-one physical row plus two diffuse uniform banks; every finite physical matrix entrywise dense with exact nonzero spectrum {1,1,-1}.
scientific_result.global_norm_status: not controlled for the one-heavy exact family; off-tip negative two-sheet peak remains open

partner_applied.applied_inequality: at theta=0.01 partner liminf norm >=4.117251705266084, exceeding the new one-heavy cone-tip limsup by >=0.32875077666040786

unresolved_implication: Control the global off-tip density, especially the negative two-sheet side, for the same one-heavy exact family; then move to several non-collinear macroscopic rows or extra active spectrum.
